job.job_description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a Engineer – AI with 2-3 years of experience in developing Generative AI applications, scalable data pipelines, and cloud-native AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess hands-on expertise in Python, SQL, Databricks, Azure, AWS, and modern AI technologies to build intelligent, production-ready applications.

The role requires close collaboration with Data Engineers, AI Architects, Product Teams, and Business Stakeholders to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), cloud platforms, and enterprise data engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

Generative AI Development

Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for structured and unstructured data.
Develop prompt engineering strategies to improve response quality and contextual accuracy.
Implement vector search, embeddings, and intelligent document retrieval solutions.
Build agentic AI workflows for multi-step business processes.

Data Engineering & ETL

Develop scalable ETL pipelines for ingesting, transforming, validating, and processing enterprise data.
Design and optimize data preprocessing workflows for structured and unstructured datasets.
Build data ingestion pipelines using REST APIs and web services.
Ensure data quality, validation, and efficient storage across cloud platforms.
Optimize pipeline performance and troubleshoot production issues.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Develop cloud-native applications using Microsoft Azure and AWS.
Utilize Databricks for large-scale data processing and analytics.
Work with Azure Data Factory, Cosmos DB, DynamoDB, and cloud storage services.
Build reusable components supporting deployment across Azure and AWS environments.

API & Application Development

Develop RESTful APIs using FastAPI.
Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems and backend services.
Design scalable backend services for AI-powered products.
Build reusable modules supporting AI workflows and enterprise integrations.

Delivery & Collaboration

Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Data Engineers, AI Architects, QA teams, and Product Owners.
Participate in Agile development and sprint planning activities.
Support testing, debugging, deployment, and production releases
Contribute to solution design and continuous platform improvements.

Roles and Responsibilities


Ideal Candidate Profile

2-3 years of experience in Machine Learning, Generative AI development.
Strong programming expertise in Python and SQL.
Hands-on experience with Databricks, Azure, and AWS cloud platforms.
Experience building ETL pipelines and data engineering solutions.
Good understanding of LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, Vector Databases, and AI workflows.
Experience developing REST APIs using FastAPI.
Knowledge of Cosmos DB, DynamoDB, and SQL databases.
Familiarity with Git/GitHub and Agile development methodologies.
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
Databricks Data Engineer Associate Certification.
Databricks GenAI Associate Certification.
Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF).
Exposure to Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
Experience building cloud-native AI applications.
Knowledge of Streamlit and AI application development.
Experience integrating enterprise APIs and cloud services.

 

Why Join Exponentia.ai?

Innovate with Purpose: Opportunity to create pioneering AI solutions in partnership with leading cloud and data platforms
Shape the Practice: Build a marquee capability from the ground up with full ownership
Work with the Best: Collaborate with top-tier talent and learn from industry leaders in AI
Global Exposure: Be part of a high-growth firm operating across US, UK, UAE, India, and Singapore
Continuous Growth: Access to certifications, tech events, and partner-led innovation labs
Inclusive Culture: A supportive and diverse workplace that values learning, initiative, and ownership
